{{Short description|Luxembourgish statistician}}
{{Orphan|date=July 2026}}
'''Christophe Ley''' is a Luxembourgish statistician,<ref>{{Cite web |last=Jacuszin |first=Hélène |date=2023-01-17 |title=SciLux podcast - Christophe Ley, associate professor in Applied Statistics |url=https://www.researchluxembourg.org/en/scilux-podcast-christophe-ley-associate-professor-in-applied-statistics/ |access-date=2024-07-10 |website=researchluxembourg |language=en}}</ref> and an author and editor of books on [[directional statistics]] and [[sports statistics]]. He is president of the Luxembourg Statistical Society.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.fenstats.eu/societies/lss|title=Luxembourg Statistical Society|publisher=Federation of European National Statistical Societies|access-date=2024-08-18}}</ref>

== Education and career==
Ley obtained his PhD from the [[Université libre de Bruxelles]] under the supervision of Davy Paindaveine.<ref>{{mathgenealogy|150205}}</ref>

After his PhD, Christophe Ley was chargé de recherche of the [[National Fund for Scientific Research]] at the Université libre de Brussels until 2015, when he became [[assistant professor]] at [[Ghent University]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Christophe Ley, Ghent University |url=https://uclouvain.be/fr/node/50576 |access-date=2024-07-10 |website=UCLouvain |language=fr}}</ref> He joined the [[University of Luxembourg]] in 2021 as associate professor.<ref name=lspb>{{Cite web |title=Luxembourg Statisticians Publish Book Combining Sports & Statistics |url=http://www.chronicle.lu/category/research-r-d/45347-luxembourg-statisticians-publish-book-combining-sports-statistics |access-date=2024-07-10 |website=Chronicle.lu}}</ref>

== Selected publications ==
Ley is the co-author, with Thomas Verdebout, of the book ''Modern Directional Statistics'' ([[CRC Press]], 2017)<ref>Reviews of ''Modern Directional Statistics'':
*Melissa A. Bingham, {{MR|3752655}}
*Shuangzhe Liu, ''Statistical Papers'', {{doi|10.1007/s00362-018-0982-4}}
</ref> and the co-editor with Verdebout of ''Applied Directional Statistics: Modern Methods and Case Studies'' (CRC Press, 2018).<ref>Review of ''Applied Directional Statistics'': Yen-Chi Chen, ''The American Statistician'', {{doi|10.1080/00031305.2021.1949931}}</ref>

He is also the co-editor, with Yves Dominicy, of ''Statistics Meets Sports: What We Can Learn from Sports Data'' ([[Cambridge Scholars Publishing]], 2023).<ref name=lspb/>
